title: Incomplete File Scanning in Project Analysis
body:
**Bug Description**
It does not perform the required task. As you can see, I asked it to check the project files. It only checks one file and then stops. When I re-request, it checks some files again and stops.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: WarpTerminal
- Version: 0.2.9
